stages.title: 1 Card reader -> abilities.md ledger + brief.md + Vault board transcription
2 Rules build, TDD (module, tools/test-fan-<key>.js, bundle)
Step check, rules: the ledger review right after the rules build / a rules fix (clean = the pass rules review)
3a Theme on (hudTheme, stub theme CSS) + shot
3b Functional HUD build: plain look, every ledger item, the HUD rules, the layout template
Step check, functional HUD: tools only (hud-coverage, test-hud-overflow every breakpoint incl. phone, contrast, text-overlap at every breakpoint + Daylight + Evening), no eye
Step fix: the Builder fixes the step findings at once, then the check runs again (rules/art up to 5 checks, HUD/judge up to 3; done at the first clean one)
4 Wireframe shot (shot-hud-themes.js --size 1920x1080 --panels -> wireframe.png)
ChatGPT check before a ChatGPT step (codex-ok.sh); out of quota = the unit waits
5 ONE concept painted over the wireframe (gen-art.sh overlay-concept) + layout check (concept-layout.py boxes), one retry
6a Clean plate (gen-art.sh clean-plate: the concept with its text removed)
6b Cut the plate (cut-plate.py -> public/Images/hud/<key>/: fixed panels, repeated parts, 9-slice frames)
7 Skin build: theme CSS on the cut parts, live text at the concept positions, its font and colours
8 Number judge (panel-judge.py vs concept-ingame.png, target 70): at most 2 skin fixes (pass 1), then the scores are recorded; never blocks
Fix Builder (the last pass findings)
9 Coverage (hud-coverage.js)
9 Art (piece-art.py, map_tts_faction_art.js, contact sheet)
Step check, art: every piece at piece size (cut, shape, style, colour), right after the art stage / an art fix
Step fix, art: the art stage fixes the piece findings at once (up to 5 checks)
Hard gate, pieces only (piece-art.py check)
Hard gates (test-fan, piece-art check, test-hud-overflow)
Shots (shot-hud-themes.js)
10 Rules review vs the ledger
10 Code review
10 UX review, usability only, not the look (Claude; codex-review.sh ux brief + the ledger ACTION list)
10 Approver (passes before the last)
10 Confirm a Sonnet approval
10 Approver, last pass
Record an early end (PARKED, blocked, no verdict)
Learner (after an approval)

rules.rule: A bot always runs its faction's Advanced Setup card; no per-seat opt-out
No edge-darkening shadows or gradients over the board, text or a closed side panel
A skinned map draws no path or river strokes; the baked art is the roads
Deferral words (TODO, for now, placeholder...) in code must cite a LEDGER:#n row
Never commit nested-repo pointers (gitlinks)
Never run _restore.bat; it wipes public/js edits
Stage files by name; never bare git add -A or git add .
Never commit with --no-verify
Never git stash pop or apply; the stash holds another writer's work
Never deploy from a dirty working tree
No playtest while the offline bundle is stale
Every edited game JS file passes node --check before the work counts as done
Bump SW_VERSION when a cache-first asset changed, before deploy
The patrol never pushes, deploys, bumps SW_VERSION, switches branches or touches tools/evolve
GPU engine changes pass the single verify.sh gate (both paths, serial pytest, compile count)
No call to a global that no loaded script defines
Never hand-edit the generated GPU map tables; regenerate them from the game's map data
Lobby ids, classes and inline handlers stay as the baseline expects
No game-state change behind an animation timer that reads shared globals at fire time
Bots never see dice before the roll, other hands, deck order or face-down plots
Fix an engine limitation in the engine; never work around it or call it inherent
One statement per line in new or touched code
Rules research order: the Law of Root first, then the Vault, then BGG / r/rootgame; record answers in the decision log
Search the Law text with grep -a; plain grep finds nothing
Each doc fact has one owner; other docs link to it; update the owner in the same commit
Never hand-edit Dominion-Wiki; regenerate it with build_wiki.js
A rules bug found in any pass is fixed in that pass, never parked
No game sounds and no factory Sound step unless the user asks
Name the model in every agent dispatch: Fable plans and final reviews, Sonnet easy jobs and diff reviews, Opus hard engine work
No Fable in the factory; Opus high where Fable was
One agent = one small job; at about 100k tokens or 40 tool calls commit, write a handoff, stop
Wait on a test with one blocking call; never poll with sleep loops or repeated tails
At most 2 test-running agents with one test lock; one testing, one coding
All agents' tests queue on the shared pytest lock; parallel coding is fine, parallel tests are not
An agent leaves no background job or monitor running when it ends
Never read huge files whole (AUDIT_LEDGER.md, big engine files, long logs); grep, then small ranges
Long unattended work runs as a fresh claude -p per run that reads a progress log first
Never SendMessage a workflow agent; have it return blocked instead
Never run GPU / JAX tests unless the user says so
While a trainer runs: no tests or probes, syntax checks only
GPU tasks run narrow tests; the full import sweep runs once at each plan's end
Pad trained nets for new factions instead of retraining from zero; new factions never change old ones
Every training or eval run appends to docs/training/ledger.json
MAX_JOBS=2, one Chrome page per shot, clear old /tmp scratch (it is RAM)
Never idle on a running test; do light non-GPU work meanwhile, never two GPU jobs
A pause before /clear means stop spawning agents, not stop the work
An option the user picked is approved; do not ask again for its redraw
Map art keeps the original concept and palette, uses atlas sprites (no code-drawn trees), textured floors; show before/after first
HUD art is repainted from the concept crop, never drawn in code or upscaled
One action = one button; same-cost or same-kind actions share a row
Every fan faction keeps its own HUD design; no shared style families
Menus never repeat a name the row shows, use one line where one does, quick play first, customizing behind an expand
Never self-rate visual quality; show the picture and list the gaps
Always send before/after shots to the user; never change what the user did not ask
ChatGPT only makes images; every review is done by Claude
The factory checks and fixes each step at once, up to 5 checks; art prompts start from the concept crop
Small look tweaks are done by hand plus the look checks, not a new factory run
Night agents improve finished elements only, never unstarted factions or pages
Every Dominion part is on the feedback tab (elements.json); fixed feedback closes at deploy
After factory changes, push the status page and update the Factory Evolution page
Run installs yourself; a password comes only from chat and is never stored
A test that pins Math.random also seeds rng.js (window.__rngSeed), or the game deals different hands each run

No live HUD text overlaps another, runs out of its panel, is covered (an element over it, or painted art under it) or is clipped, at every breakpoint and in Birdsong, Daylight and Evening (fan factory hudCheck + judge)

Text removed (only inside the text boxes)
Parts cut from the clean picture

workflows.name: Feedback helper
workflows.what: Works on your feedback and your answers to rules questions.
workflows.starts: Every 30 minutes. Costs nothing when there is no work.
steps: Verdict: reproduced, already fixed or cannot reproduce
Fix the root cause (only if reproduced)
Add the check that keeps it fixed
Record it on the Agent changes tab
workflows.may: Its branch feedback; a factory worktree that is not running.
workflows.never: Hooks, CLAUDE.md, the factory script, deploys, GPU tests.

workflows.name: Patrol
workflows.what: Checks one FINISHED part (faction, page) and fixes one problem.
workflows.starts: Every 4 hours. Skips when the factory is busy.
steps: Repeat cause: build a check instead
workflows.may: Its branch patrol; finished parts only.
workflows.never: Parts not finished or not started, deploys.

workflows.name: Hardener
workflows.what: Turns one written (soft) rule into an automatic check.
steps: Pick one soft rule or lesson
Prove it fails on the bad case
workflows.may: Its branch hardener; tests, lint and check scripts.
workflows.never: Game code, hooks, CLAUDE.md, your chats.

workflows.name: Night tests
workflows.what: Runs every test of the game on this computer (GitHub no longer runs them).
workflows.starts: Every night at 03:30. Skips when training runs.

workflows.name: Instruction tests
workflows.what: Tests the helpers' instructions on sample jobs; a second model gives a score.
workflows.starts: When the lead runs it, after a helper's instructions change.
steps: Plant a sample job in a copy
uses: Opus or Sonnet as the helper
workflows.may: A throwaway copy; no GitHub writes, no push.

workflows.name: Deploy
workflows.starts: Only when you say deploy in a chat.
steps: Last night's tests must be green

workflows.name: Status page
workflows.what: Builds this website and turns open rules questions into tickets.
steps: Read the factory, git, tests and helpers
workflows.never: Local paths or private text on the page.

questions.title: [blackpaw] Vagabond item trade "Vagabond can give you cards to take these items." (board, Crafted ...
questions.body:
Plain: When can the Vagabond trade cards for items from your Crafted Items box?
Choice A (built now): Any time in its own turn, 1 card per item.
Choice B: Only in Daylight.
Choice C: It costs more than 1 card per item.

---
Vagabond item trade "Vagabond can give you cards to take these items." (board, Crafted Items box): the board names no phase and no rate. Built (fan-rules-1 step fix, Vault/decision-log.md blackpaw-vagabond-item-trade): any phase of the Vagabond's turn, 1 card per item, the Vagabond picks the card. Say so if it is Daylight only or costs more.

questions.title: [blackpaw] Ransom "Return enemy warriors to their owners supply, as if they are returning from bat...
questions.body:
Plain: Ransom: who picks the clearing the freed warriors come back from?
Choice A (built now): The first clearing next to the forest; they go home like battle losses.
Choice B: The Bandits pick the clearing.
Choice C: The owner of the warriors picks it.

---
Ransom "Return enemy warriors to their owners supply, as if they are returning from battle from any one adjacent clearing": built (fan-rules-1 step fix) as every kidnapped warrior (in any forest) goes home through the battle-removal path (combat.js vbAllyFallen: a Marquise may use Field Hospitals, Mousehold applies) from the FIRST clearing next to its forest; only those in a hideout forest score +2. Say who picks the clearing (the Bandits, the owner) and whether "any one adjacent clearing" limits which warriors return. Emancipation's Ransom (0 VP) goes the same way.

questions.body:
Plain: A dry clearing has a map Ruin. Can a cache go there, and which Ruin is explored first?
Choice A (built now): The cache goes in its own slot; the map Ruin is explored first.
Choice B: Same, but the explorer picks which Ruin goes first.

questions.title: [pirates] "Buried tokens are treated like Ruin tokens": a Ruin gives one item, but a Bury may put...
questions.body:
Plain: A Bury may hide two items under one token. Who gets both when it is cleared?
Choice A (built now): Whoever clears it takes both items.
Choice B: They take one; the second stays under the token.
Choice C: They take one; the second goes back to the supply.

---
